description: PINK-LOGIC v2 — máquina de conteúdo: API central + web + MCP para agentes (Athena)
name: pink-logic

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/api && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/web
scripts.test:carousel: npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/api && node --test tests/carousel-content.test.mjs
scripts.test:posts: npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/api && node --test tests/meta-graph.test.mjs
scripts.test:routing: npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/shared && npm run build --workspace=@pink-logic/api && node scripts/bundle-functions.mjs && node --test tests/routing-dispatch.test.mjs
